settings.title: Minimum age
settings.text: Lingo Leap is made and dosed for children 3 and up. Please don’t give it to children under 3.

settings.title: Don’t exceed 1 mL a day
settings.text: More isn’t better. Stick to one dropper a day.

settings.title: Medication or health conditions
settings.text: If your child takes medication or has a health condition, check with your pediatrician first.

settings.title: Stop if anything seems off
settings.text: Stop and call your doctor if your child has vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain or any unusual reaction.

settings.title: Not a medicine
settings.text: Lingo Leap is a dietary supplement, not a medicine.

settings.question: What does it taste like?
settings.answer: A natural berry flavor most kids enjoy. If your child is sensitive to flavors, mix it into their favorite drink.

settings.question: How long does a bottle last?
settings.answer: Each 30 mL (1 fl oz) bottle holds 30 servings at 1 mL a day: one month of daily use.

settings.question: When is the best time to give it?
settings.answer: With food, at any time of day. Consistency matters more than timing, so pick a moment that fits your routine.

settings.question: When will we notice a difference?
settings.answer: Every child is different. Many parents notice changes in focus and daily routines within 2–4 weeks; we recommend 30–45 days of daily use.*

settings.question: The liquid looks cloudy or has separated. Is that okay?
settings.answer: Yes. Zeolite is a natural mineral, so it can settle and the color can vary slightly between batches. Shake well before each use.

settings.question: Can my child take it with other supplements or medication?
settings.answer: If your child takes any medication or other supplements, please check with your pediatrician or pharmacist before adding Lingo Leap.
